Amazon refers to its top-line figure as “Net sales,” which is its total revenue measure under U.S. GAAP. In the FY2024 Form 10-K consolidated statement of operations, Amazon reports:

- Net sales for fiscal year 2024: $637,959 million (i.e., $637.959 billion) [DOC]

This is presented as “Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959” in the consolidated statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024. [DOC]

ANSWER: $637.959 billion in net sales (total revenue) for fiscal year 2024
